b65536DegreeOnePackMedianTotalTrial.selection: Fifth raw trial; its total of 8544087 ns is the five-sample median.

differentialDiagnosis.digestInterpretation: Digest is 78.30% of the median-total trial, but native computes the same canonical ordered digest. It cannot be removed, skipped, moved, or relabeled as the crossover lever. An implementation optimization is admissible only if every byte in the same stream is processed in the same order and the full work remains inside timing.
differentialDiagnosis.scopeWarning: Native prepared excludes native assignment and digest while including native eval and output collection; it is a directional diagnostic only, not an equal-scope speed ratio.
differentialDiagnosis.combinationRequired: The 1.122170 ms direct paired gap exceeds any single HELUT non-digest phase median, so no one local non-digest micro-lever can close it by itself at unchanged native time.
nextSafeInvestigationOrder: Exact degree-one strict output collection/decode specialization that still binds and reads every output value, validates strict constant-fill semantics, and materializes all 589,824 B=65536 values inside the existing decode phase.
Measure and reduce the explicit MPSGraph executable/submission/synchronization floor without moving the synchronized graph boundary or changing graph semantics.
If the fixed graph floor remains binding, design a larger fused Yosys-to-Metal backend rather than accumulating benchmark-only host micro-optimizations.

notes: No benchmark was rerun after the sole preregistered execution.

The first generated-copy hash check detected added terminal newlines in lut6.v, flow.ys, and tb.cpp. Only those copy-only EOF bytes were removed; the corrected copies then matched the preserved run hashes exactly.

The final mechanical validator passed all width, sample-count, sign, residual, phase-total agreement, digest, XCTest, crossover-reporting, source byte-identity, native-binary, Yosys-JSON, and sealed-baseline checks.

conclusions.statement: The exact degree-one input-pack specialization reduced the B=65536 input-pack median from 1.240015 ms to 0.528932 ms and HELUT paired total from 9.504080 ms to 8.544087 ms while preserving all 1,114,112 writes per trial, strict exhaustive output coverage, and digest equality. HELUT remained 1.151x slower than the contemporaneous 7.421917 ms native paired median, leaving a 1.122170 ms gap.
conclusions.nextDifferentialLever: Audit an exact degree-one strict output collection/decode specialization first, then isolate the synchronized MPSGraph execution floor; if those local levers cannot jointly close the gap, move to a larger fused Yosys-to-Metal backend.

claimBoundaries: The ratios are descriptive medians from five unpinned trials, not a significance claim.
Independent phase medians do not add to the total median; median-total-trial fractions are reported separately.
The graph and native movements versus the sealed baseline include run-to-run variance and are not attributed to the input-pack source change.
One combinational 8-bit ripple adder on one Mac16,5 host.
No equal-scope NATIVE_EVAL metric was synthesized from independent medians.
No work, pointer binding, strict validation, digest byte, assignment, lane, or trial was moved, skipped, weakened, or selected after observation.
No general Swift, Metal, Apple, HDL, sequential, encrypted, cross-host, or best-possible-native claim follows.
